parse.title: Legend Stages
parse.text:
Legend Stages are stages that are separate from story. Furthermore, you need to previously have unlocked and beaten the Act 6 of the story the Legend Stage is from.

As of now, all of the Legend Stages are designed to provide evolution materials for newer characters. Additionally, certain Legend Stages provide crafting materials for Relics.

Ex: You need Soul (Wes) item from Karakora Town you would need to previously have beaten Hollow World Act 6 to unlock this legend stage.
